chunks: Whoever shrouds a believer, it is as though he has guaranteed his clothing until the Day of Resurrection; and whoever digs a grave for a believer, it is as though he has settled him in a suitable house until the Day of Resurrection.

key_terms.بَوَّأَهُ: settled him or prepared a place for him
key_terms.كَفَّنَ: to shroud the deceased in a burial cloth
key_terms.مُؤْمِنًا: a believer, meaning a faithful person

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for shrouding and burying a believer in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the immense reward of serving a deceased believer through shrouding and burial. It portrays these acts of care and dignity as lasting provisions whose reward endures until the Day of Resurrection.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.417 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Whoever shrouds a believer, it is as if they have guaranteed their clothing until the Day of Resurrection. And whoever digs a grave for a believer, it is as if they have prepared for them a suitable dwelling until the Day of Resurrection."
